errors.evidence: Description says the 2K-Output bar reaches approximately 78,188, but the figure shows 78,188 for the 4K-Input.
The description incorrectly states that the input values decrease monotonically from the 2K to the 16K group, which is not accurate.
The description states that the horizontal axis contains four groups corresponding to token length ranges, but it also includes both input and output, which makes it misleading.
The description does not mention that the 2K range refers to the interval [2K, 4K) and similarly for other ranges.
